invariants.rationale: The context parameter is used directly in a constructor call, so it must not be null to avoid a NullPointerException.
restoreInstantTimestamp is passed directly to the CopyOnWriteRestoreActionExecutor, so it should not be null.
restoreInstantTimestamp likely represents an instant identifier, which should be a non-empty string.
savepointToRestoreTimestamp is given to the executor; typically, it should not be null when used to specify a savepoint for restore operations.
The savepointToRestoreTimestamp should be a non-empty string identifier, as empty values may not be valid in the restore context.
